# Vamp Terminal

> Open-source multi-tab terminal workspace for iPhone and iPad. It connects to
> Vamp Host or Vamp Terminal Host over signed pairing and a private Tailscale
> network, and can also be controlled from Safari without the iOS app.

Canonical name: Vamp Terminal
Full host: Vamp Host
Terminal-only host: Vamp Terminal Host
iOS client: Vamp Terminal for iPhone and iPad
Linux companion: Vamp Terminal Linux Host
Website: https://mesutcydev.github.io/macpair/
Source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/macpair
License: Apache-2.0
Minimum macOS: 13.0
Minimum iOS/iPadOS: 18.0
iOS signing: unsigned; AltStore or another sideload tool must re-sign the IPA with the installer's Apple ID/team

## Agent quick start

vamp ensure
vamp status --json
vamp pending --json
vamp approve-pairing --fingerprint <verified-hex>
vamp terminal list
vamp terminal start --session work
vamp terminal attach work
vamp terminal agent opencode --session opencode
vamp terminal agent claude --session claude
vamp terminal agent codex --session codex
vamp browser serve

Never approve an unknown device. Show the user the pending display name and
fingerprint and require an exact verified fingerprint. Never disable Gatekeeper.
A human must grant Screen Recording and Accessibility to Vamp Host when using
remote display/control. Vamp Terminal Host does not request those permissions.

## Stable identifiers

Full host bundle ID: com.mesutcy.remotedesktop.host
Terminal-only host bundle ID: com.mesutcy.remotedesktop.terminalhost
iOS client bundle ID: com.mesutcy.remotedesktop.terminal
Bonjour service: _screenharbor._tcp (existing wire-compatibility contract)
Signaling ports: 9471 plain, 9473 TLS
Data port: 9472
Browser loopback port: 9475
URL scheme: vamphost://action/{start,stop,restart}
Status snapshot: ~/Library/Application Support/Vamp Host/host.widget.snapshot.json
